LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_Intro: Each nicety is optional. Off means vanilla for that one rule. Combat, fire, and outdoor rot are never blocked.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_PresetsTip: Presets only change the knobs. After that, tick the niceties you actually want.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_ApparelCareTip: Worn clothes skip or scale the daily deterioration tick. Combat and fire still damage hit points. Clothes left on the ground still rot outdoors.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_QualityScaleTip: Off: no daily wear while worn (Soft). On: awful/poor wear like vanilla; good and excellent wear less; masterwork and legendary skip daily wear.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CraftingBonusTip: A pawn's Crafting skill reduces remaining daily wear, up to half at level 20.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CorpseApparel: Keep the same rule on corpses
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CorpseApparelTip: Off: apparel on a dead pawn deteriorates as vanilla. On: the worn-care rule still applies.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_ThroneAltarTip: Royalty throne-room requirements ignore "no altars". A throne in the room keeps it a throne room instead of a temple. Needs Royalty + Ideology to matter.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_WearAnyTip: Clears apparel gender tags (royal vest/corset, hats, and any mod that uses the same field) so the wrong-gender thought does not apply.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_HideCrypto: Hide cryptosleep pawns from the bar
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_HideCryptoTip: Colonists already in a cryptosleep casket are omitted from the colonist bar. They stay visible while being carried to a casket.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_MeleeHuntTip: Hunters may hunt with a melee weapon. Ranged hunting is unchanged.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_UnarmedHuntTip: Hunters with no weapon may still hunt (fists). Off by default — easy to get someone killed.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_SharedRoomsTip: A gizmo on a bed marks the room as shared. It stays a bedroom instead of flipping to barracks, so roommates (and royalty) are not punished for living together.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_SkipDisturbedSleepTip: Pawns who share a room (marked shared, or another colonist assigned a bed there) do not gain the disturbed-sleep thought. Walking through someone else's private room still disturbs them.
LanguageData.Niceties_ShareRoomTip: Mark this bedroom as shared. Extra beds stay a bedroom instead of a barracks. Roommates skip the sharing-a-room mood hit.
LanguageData.Niceties_Hunt_TooBig: {0} is too large for melee hunting.
